entries.3bc564f5796a62a6: The company's management philosophy is “Our HOSHI IRYO-SANKI Group will continue to contribute to society at the forefront of protecting life (inochi),” and it positions five core businesses: the Medical Gas-Related Business, Home Medical Care-Related Business, Medical Gas Facility Construction-Related Business, Nursing Care and Welfare-Related Business, and Facility Nursing Care-Related Business. It sees the shift of medical and nursing care services from inpatient-centered care to home-based and community-based care as a growth opportunity, and states that it will work on strengthening its service delivery system through coordination between medical and nursing care, strengthening sales capabilities, expanding its business base through M&A, and promoting DX, among other measures.

entries.f6b5df679a4c96a4: Medical gas is a lifeline directly tied to patients' survival, and the company group regards maintaining its supply network on a 24-hour, 365-day basis as a social responsibility.
